purpose: Scheduling aid for the work packages, not a replacement for formal node approval.

dependency_semantics.start_after: All listed tasks have accepted outputs, except conclusion_only dependencies.
dependency_semantics.evidence_after: Work can start earlier, but cannot be accepted before this evidence is available.
dependency_semantics.conclusion_only: The dependency may be accepted or explicitly blocked/deferred with an evidence-backed conclusion; this does not waive mandatory acceptance.
dependency_semantics.final_report_after: All listed work is stopped in a known state; missing mandatory evidence produces PARTIAL_WITH_BLOCKERS, never READY_FOR_OWNER_PREVIEW.

tasks.scope: Intake, actual plan, ownership and CP0
Real dpkg control-field and command-exit contract
Windows stub provenance and launch environment
Actual Linux build, ABI, probe and publication evidence
Explicit cross-platform teardown schema and full replay
Windows cwd/profile failures, without normalizer or global-state bypass
Real isolated Electron startup and interaction
Runnable Windows preview and optional unsigned installer
Source-derived bilingual event facts and stale line references
Read-only evidence inventory for all 32 product acceptance criteria
Exact P0-B prerequisites and consolidated owner inputs; no successor activation
Integration, mandatory user journeys and complete candidate manifest
Full fixed-candidate review, normal delivery or precise partial report

invariants: W01 and W02 never edit prepare-ci-bubblewrap.spec.ts concurrently.
Only the coordinator integrates files, runs shared generators, changes refs or pushes.
A task waiting for CI does not block unrelated desktop, documentation or read-only inventory work.
A task under review is frozen; the final candidate freeze applies to every writer.
If W04 is waiting only for Linux evidence, it may hand a frozen local snapshot to W05; W04 remains unaccepted until its evidence arrives.
No task enters P0-C or declares product acceptance merely because the maintenance batch is complete.
No missing mandatory result becomes optional through conclusion_only scheduling.
